children: West Pharmaceutical Services entered into a new unsecured credit agreement providing a $750 million revolving credit facility and a $200 million term loan, with a five-year term. The company used part of the new borrowings to repay the $130 million outstanding under its March 28, 2019 credit agreement, which it terminated on October 26, 2026 without early termination penalties. The new facilities support the company's liquidity and general corporate needs.

: Bank of America and participating lenders
